rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the grammatical plural number.

example.english: In English, plural is the grammatical number used to show more than one.
example.traditional: 英文入面，複數係文法上用嚟表示多過一個嘅數目。
example.jyutping: jing1 man4 jap6 min6 fuk1 sou3 hai6 man4 faat3 soeng6 jung6 lei4 biu2 si6 do1 gwo3 jat1 go3 ge3 sou3 muk6

rows.note: Use this when referring specifically to the form of a word used for more than one.

example.english: The plural form of this noun is different from the singular form.
example.traditional: 呢個名詞嘅複數形式同單數形式唔同。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ming4 ci4 ge3 fuk1 sou3 jing4 sik1 tung4 daan1 sou3 jing4 sik1 m4 tung4
